blocks.label: Контентная карточка
blocks.pug:
table.row.white-bg
    tr
        td.offset-by-one
            table.ten.columns
                tr
                    td.no-padding-bottom
                        p.title Dear Trader,
                        p.text We tried to reach you telephonically this week, without success.
                        p.text The purpose of the call was a courtesy call to discuss your investment in our platform, to inquire what else you would like to see on IQ Option and in general to see if you have questions or queries.
                        p.text Our purpose is to offer support and deliver useful information to you to enhance your experience with our company.
                        p.text Kindly advise when is a convenient time for us to call you, alternatively, I invite you to direct your queries here to our 24-hour customer support at 
                            a(href="mailto:support@iqoption.com" target="_blank") support@iqoption.com
